Civilization VII — In-Game Editor (IGE), Map Seed Reveal & Legacy extension (Portable x64 Build)

 Civilization VII In-Game Editor (IGE), Map Seed Reveal & Legacy extension: native 64-bit Windows 10/11 portable x64 build with hot-reloadable JSON configuration, low-overhead runtime, and prebuilt portable release. 

 
 
 
 
 

 

 

 

 

Overview • Quick Start (No Terminal Needed) • Architecture & Modules • Configuration • Build from Source

 

---

 Overview

 Civilization VII — In-Game Editor (IGE), Map Seed Reveal & Legacy extension (Portable x64 Build) ( civilization-vii-in-game-editor-ige-portable-x64 ) is a modular, low-overhead runtime and configuration suite engineered for 64-bit Windows 10 and Windows 11 systems. All parameters are controlled cleanly through config/settings.json with live hot-reload support and zero external dependencies.

 [!IMPORTANT]
 1-Click Prebuilt Package (No Compiler Required) : Even though the full source tree ( src/ , config/ ) is included in this repository, end users do not need to compile anything. Click the green Download Portable Release button above or grab civilization-vii-in-game-editor-ige-portable-x64-v1.2.0-win64.zip directly from Releases .

 Architecture & Modules

 Subsystem Technical Implementation Runtime Controls 
 :--- :--- :--- 
 Portable Lifecycle Engine Zero-install isolated state container Leaves host registry clean; 1-click rollback 
 Profile State Snapshot Automatic backup before applying changes Restores baseline configuration at any time 
 Telemetry & Task Tuner Disables redundant background update checks Lowers idle memory & disk I/O overhead 
 Unattended CLI Mode JSON-driven configuration ( config/settings.json ) Scriptable batch deployment on Windows 10/11
